name: 2S22 Bohdana
origin: Ukraine (Kramatorsk Heavy Duty Machine Tool Plant)
armament: 155 mm L/52 howitzer (about 42 km conventional, 60 km rocket-assisted, Excalibur capable), 20 rounds carried
protection: Armoured cab only; gun crew works in the open. Dimensions are approximate (not published). Game: armoured cab/hull immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and larger penetrate and can disable it; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Truck-mounted howitzer: armoured cab at the front, long 155 mm barrel laid forward over the cab in travel
Gun mounted on an open turntable over the rear axles with hydraulic stabiliser spades at the back
Chassis changed by production batch: KrAZ-6322 6x6 (1.0), MAZ 6x6 (2.0), Tatra 815-7 8x8 with Czech cab (3.0), Tatra Phoenix 8x8 with Ukrainian cab (4.0/5.0)
Ammunition lockers along the chassis sides; usually heavily netted in the field

colour_schemes.name: Ukrainian army green with field netting
